title: Leading hypnosis questions about the Nine heard on tapes

tellings.quote: speculation. Like on the tapes, you can very much hear him saying, you know, is it is it the nine

related.note: Hypnosis tapes in which Puharich himself suggests the Nine. This tells the Nine coming through under hypnosis as Puharich's leading questions rather than real contact, which is a different core claim about the same kind of session.

plain: On tapes from 1970s hypnosis sessions, the researcher Andrija Puharich can be heard asking his subject leading questions such as "is it the nine", referring to the Nine, a council of non-human beings that messages from these sessions were said to come from. The researcher Greg Malatzi says so, describing the tapes himself without naming another source, and calls the questioning "speculation" on Puharich's part. If so, the Nine may have been suggested by the hypnotist rather than offered by the subject.
